fact: The plugin validates an agent-selected Work State in Design and Implement and supplies its context, prompt, model, and tools. Design waits for both independent member results for the candidate before dispatching Lead revision or signoff.
Design and Implement submit the next Work State and its structured result together; the plugin accepts only a declared transition and waits for the next Work Turn to complete.
The plugin creates the implementer session after the approved design taskbook has been committed.
Each Work Turn uses a fresh Pi SDK session. The named seat keeps its configured model and reasoning level across turns.
A designer turn accepts a result only for its pending turn ID and settles it once.
The dispatcher waits for all calls in a batch to settle before processing their outcomes and dispatching another batch.
The original Pi session keeps a tool call active while the named team works. Fact intake waits for the team directly, and team work after a user decision runs through taskbook_run_team.

When Pi exposes the Taskbook worker transport, each named Work Turn emits nested subagent tool events under the original Pi call. The T3 Pi adapter reads details.results to show the seat, Work State, current tool activity and terminal status. Each Work Turn runs in a Pi SDK session.

Each Design Work Turn gets a fresh Pi worker session and receives its current assignment. An initial confirmation receives the full assignment. A recheck receives the latest resolutions, the previous and current text of changed steps, and affected requirements and target IDs. Designers can inspect fixed local Git evidence and, when Magpie GitHub is available, fixed upstream evidence. A Design run shares successful reads of the same upstream repository, commit and path across work turns.
A distinct work prompt has a distinct Work State. An iteration counter can reuse a state when its work prompt remains the same.
For phases served by buildPhaseInput, the plugin includes the method index in the phase prompt. Named-team workers outside Review can consult taskbook_method on demand.
